summary: Frontend-only testing of POSScreen.jsx major UX overhaul (7 features). All 31 tested behaviors passed across 3 playwright runs at mobile viewport 420x900.

issues: toggle-kiloan-detail and photo-upload-button sit below the sticky bottom bar on a 420x900 viewport; they are accessible via scroll (pb-44 provides spacing) but Playwright needed evaluate()+click to dispatch clicks because scroll_into_view_if_needed still leaves them partially under the sticky bar — real users on mobile can scroll so not blocking.

critical_code_review_comments: Search result button uses onMouseDown={e => e.preventDefault()} to avoid blur race — works correctly, but makes native onClick brittle with some automated click simulations (had to use direct .click() via evaluate in one attempt). Consider using onPointerDown preventDefault instead.

kiloan-detail counters never feed into `subtotal`/`total` (correct per spec) but the state `kiloanDetail` is reset in resetAll yet never persisted into order payload — fine for MVP, note that QR payload does not include detail counts.
`Building` icon is inline SVG fallback (missing import) — works, but consider importing from lucide-react's Building2 for consistency.
resetAll does not reset `searchQuery`, `searchOpen`, or `trackOrder` — harmless because search is independent, but could be surprising if new-order-button is used mid-search.
`useEffect([minKg, kiloanKg])` writes state when kiloanKg<minKg which can briefly cause double render — acceptable.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All 7 features pass: (1) search bar with autocomplete + tracking modal (6 stages), (2) customer-name-input + sumber dropdown (walkin/tamel/anter/kosan), (3) member-badge on kosan, (4) min-kg-hint on anter = 3.0 kg + auto-bump, (5) manual kiloan input typing 5.5 → Rp 33.000, decrease disabled at min, clamp 1.0→2.0 for walkin with toast, (6) toggle-kiloan-detail expands kiloan-detail-list + kemeja counter doesn't affect total, (7) photo-upload-button adds thumbs, payment toggle lunas↔nanti, proof required for lunas, save-blocked-hint shows 'Upload bukti pembayaran dulu', happy-path save yields QR with LND- order id, new-order-button resets state, other routes /production /courier /admin load. NOTE: use page.evaluate("() => el.click()") for buttons below the sticky bottom bar (toggle-kiloan-detail, photo-upload-button, payment buttons, save-print-button, proof button) because sticky bar at fixed bottom-0 z-50 can occlude them even with scroll_into_view_if_needed.
rca of the issue: No bugs found. Initial playwright failures were test-harness issues (sticky bottom bar occluding clicks; search-result onMouseDown race) — resolved by using evaluate-based click.
